easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Death Cultist by sacrificing it.
When Death Cultist dies, Yedora triggers, returning Death Cultist from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Death Cultist enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Death Cultist by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Death Cultist face-up.
Resolve the Death Cultist ability from step 1.
Repeat.
